proceedings.outcome: The applicant was found guilty of misappropriation, embezzlement, larceny, bribery, and attempt not to return money from abroad. He was sentenced to six years in prison and ordered to pay damages to the "Oka" shipyard and three other companies.

proceedings.outcome: The Supreme Court confirmed the judgment of the Regional Court with some alterations.
